output.rationale: The requirement specifies compliance with IEEE standards for high-voltage circuit breakers and is part of a specification for metal-clad switchgear. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear lineup that meets relevant IEEE standards, including IEEE C37.20.7. This product aligns with the technical requirements and the specification context.
